payload.name: Search plan and event memories for scheduled activities
payload.description: When a user asks when someone is attending, visiting, or participating in a future or scheduled activity (e.g., conference, appointment, trip), include plan memories in the search before concluding no information is available.
content: When the question asks about a future or scheduled activity (attending, visiting, participating), do not restrict memory_kinds to event; include plan memories in the hybrid or structured search.

If the first search returns no direct match, retry with a broader memory_kind filter (include plan, and profile if relevant) and query terms like 'plans to attend', 'will attend', or 'next month' before answering 'No information available'.
Stop once a relevant plan or event memory is found; do not exhaustively search all kinds when sufficient evidence is retrieved.

solves: When a user asks about a future or scheduled activity (e.g., 'When is Tim attending a book conference?'), the agent may restrict the search to event-kind memories and miss the plan memory that contains the date. This Skill applies to any future or scheduled activity query where the answer may be stored as a plan; before answering 'no information', search both plan and event memory kinds (or without kind restriction) and resolve relative-time phrases. It does not apply to questions about past events or preferences where event-only search is already sufficient.
